territorial_scope.description: Applies to all persons and to social media platforms offering services in Chile, including foreign platforms reached through listed criteria such as a .cl domain or Chilean payment methods.

evidence.quote: se aplicará a las plataformas digitales de redes sociales que ofrezcan sus servicios en el territorio nacional.

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Bill protecting persons' identity and integrity against realistic false digital representations of their image, body or voice made or altered with AI. Prohibits generating or disseminating them, requires social media platforms to label AI content and resolve takedown complaints within 72 hours, and provides civil liability and fines. In force six months after publication.
summary.long: Bill (committee-approved text, Boletín 17795-19) protecting persons' identity and integrity against realistic false digital representations of their image, body or voice made or altered with AI or other technology. Article 6 prohibits generating or disseminating such representations; Article 3 defines them, and Article 5 exempts clearly labelled satire, parody, criticism or artistic expression. Article 2 applies the law to all persons and to social media platforms offering services in Chile, under criteria including a .cl domain or local payment methods. Platforms must appoint a Chilean legal representative (Art. 4), label AI-generated or manipulated audio, image and video (Art. 7), and resolve takedown complaints within 72 hours (Art. 10). Courts may order removal or blocking on request and impose civil liability for damages (Arts. 8-9). The Data Protection Agency imposes fines of 5,000 to 10,000 monthly tax units, weighted by factors including harm to minors and recidivism (Arts. 11-12). The law takes effect six months after publication.

entities.name: Tribunales ordinarios de justicia
entities.function: May order removal or blocking of content at the request of the affected person, and measures to prevent ongoing harm where there is imminent irreparable danger (Art. 9).

evidence.quote: Los tribunales ordinarios de justicia

notes: Text is the committee-approved version (Título VII of the committee report) of a bill with status pending; no later stage is shown in the document. Art. 7 requires labelling of 'toda imagen, audio o video que haya sido generado o manipulado mediante IA', which is broader than the Art. 3(1) definition of synthetic representations. Art. 12 sets a fine of 5.000 to 10.000 UTM, which is a fine range and not a threshold. Relation targets are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty.

obligations.summary: Platforms not domiciled or incorporated in Chile that offer services in the national territory must designate a legal representative domiciled in the country, with sufficient powers, to answer to administrative and judicial authorities; the designation is to be accredited before the Agency, and each platform must keep that information up to date. Non-compliance is an infringement.
obligations.applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
obligations.conditional_on: Platform is not domiciled or constituted in Chile but offers services in the national territory

evidence.quote: deberán designar un representante legal con domicilio en el país

obligations.summary: Generating or disseminating realistic but false digital representations of a person's image, body or voice, as described in the law, is prohibited.
obligations.applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
obligations.conditional_on: Content meets the definition of a 'representación digital verosímil pero falsa' and is not exempt under Art. 5

evidence.quote: Toda generación o difusión de representaciones digitales verosímiles pero falsas, en los términos descritos en esta ley, se encontrará prohibida.

obligations.summary: Social media platforms must identify and clearly inform, through visible labels or distinctive marks, any image, audio or video generated or manipulated by AI. Non-compliance is an infringement.
obligations.applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)

evidence.quote: deberán identificar e informar de manera clara, mediante el uso de etiquetas visibles o sellos distintivos, toda imagen, audio o video que haya sido generado o manipulado mediante IA

obligations.summary: Each social media platform must provide a complaint channel on its website or user interface through which affected persons, their heirs or legal representatives can request removal of such representations; the platform must decide within 72 hours of the request, and the channels must operate free of arbitrariness or discrimination. Non-compliance, including unjustified failure to decide within the period, is an infringement.
obligations.applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)

evidence.quote: cada plataforma digital de redes sociales dispondrá de un canal de denuncias en su página web o interfaz de usuario

enforcement.penalty_formula: Amount set by the Agencia within the range, applying the criteria in Art. 12 letters a) to f) (potential harm, scope on the platform, economic capacity, reparation, cooperation, recidivism); if the same facts fall under this and other laws, the more serious sanction applies
